name: agent-bom
summary: Security scanner for AI infrastructure and supply chain. Discover MCP configs (22 clients), generate SBOMs, scan for CVEs (OSV/NVD/EPSS/KEV), map blast radius to credentials and tools, runtime proxy with 7 detectors, 32 MCP tools, CIS benchmarks (AWS/Azure/GCP/Snowflake), MITRE ATT&CK mapping, 14-framework compliance, and 16 output formats.
